name: Unwip 0.43.23
body:
New icon:
- One Unwip icon everywhere, matching the logo: three coral dots (an empty ring, a half and a full dot) on soft blue. It replaces the dark navy icon, and the small version whose first dot looked white.
- Every size is drawn for its size, so it stays crisp from the taskbar to the Home Screen.
- Windows may take a little while (or a restart) to show the new icon on shortcuts, because it keeps old icons in a cache.
